items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Every time I saw him, we’d talk. We’d talk a long time. We were very friendly.

ctx.x: Because he spent a lot of time at Minton’s, I would think, among other places...
Not at Minton’s. He was at Blue Note. Every time I went down there, Monk and his wife would be down there, at the company, down there in back of Bloomingdale’s. They’d be down there all the time.
